name: statusline-hub
description: The status-line slot, shared — the hub owns the statusLine command (taking a free slot on the first session, never another tool's without consent), records the context depth and plan usage Claude Code hands the status line into the sensor record other tools read, then runs the display and record hooks other plugins register; where another renderer keeps the slot, its tee command feeds the same record from a ccstatusline Custom Command, a Starship custom module, or a wrapper around your own command. (Soft dependency: statusline — the hub waits for its footer to register as a hub display hook, then takes over its slot.)
